seoTitle: Killeen, Mountmellick, Emo, Co. Laois, R32V0F3
description:
TOM MCDONALD & ASSOCIATES – EXPERIENCED, PROFESSIONAL, TRUSTED – have been favoured with the sale of this Idyllic Rural Property in a Countryside Setting yet just a short drive to the towns of Portlaoise, Mountmellick & Portarlington, Co. Laois as well as the M7 Motorway.

Presenting to you this Superb 4 Bed, 3 Reception Detached Bungalow on a Beautiful Landscaped Site with Potential for Additional Space in the Massive Floored Attic with stairs access. 

Solar Panels were installed in Recent Years providing Electricity & Hot Water.

This Wonderful Family Home has a B2 BER Rating meaning it will qualify for a Green Mortgage.

Originally constructed to a High Standard in 2007, this Ideal Family Home extends to approximately 2,785sq.ft. offering ample accommodation for every family’s needs.

In the Kitchen/Dining Area there is a Beautiful Solid Oak Fitted Kitchen with Granite Worksurface, Island and Feature Stanley Cooker, a Staple in any Country Home. 

A must have for all homes is the Separate Utility Room with Fitted Units & Access to Rear Garden. With Space for Washing Machine & Dryer, there is a WC with Partially Panelled Walls & a Walk-in-Hotpress off the Utility making it the perfect place to return inside after a day in the garden. 

With 3 Reception Rooms offering different options, there is a Triple Aspect Sun Room off the Kitchen/Dining  Area with Feature Stove and French Doors to the Rear. A Second Reception Room off the Dining Area is the Main Living Room which has a Bay Window and Decorative Panelling on the Walls. A Solid Fuel Stove with Stone Surround creates a Cosy Atmosphere in the Evening.

The 3rd Reception Room which is off the Entrance Hall is currently in use as a Playroom but could be used as an Additional Bedroom or Home Office, with the large space it is suitable for a variety of uses.

All 4 Bedrooms are Good Size Double Rooms. The Main Bedroom with Bay Window boasts a Walk-in-Wardrobe & Fully Tiled En-Suite. There are 2 further Bedrooms that share a Fully Tiled Jack’n’Jill Shower Room. One of the Bedrooms that use the Jack’n’Jill Shower Room has a Walk-in-Wardobe whilst the other Bedroom has a Sliderobe. The 4th Bedroom is a Spacious Room with Fitted Storage. 

The Family Bathroom, which is also a Generous Room, is Fully Tiled and boasts a Corner Jacuzzi Bath & Separate Shower. 

The Grounds of this Rural Idyl provide the Perfect Space to have a more Self-Sufficient Lifestyle. Raised Vegetable Beds, Greenhouse & an Enclosed Orchard with Room for chickens, this could be the Country Lifestyle you have been longing for. 

Let’s make it yours!

To view this Magnificent Home, contact our office today on 057 8623643.

Services: Well Water, Septic Tank. Fibre Broadband.
